integrity: The all-level proof is an induction; finite program checks are supplementary and independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only a constructive lower bound of 2k-1 minimal absent factors for each k >= 3 is proved; the all-k exact count is not claimed.
Exhaustive finite counts for k=3..8 are supplementary and do not establish a general upper bound.
Restricted to binary dyadic prefixes of 0 -> 01, 1 -> 00 and to contiguous factors.
title: Explicit logarithmic antidictionaries for dyadic period-doubling prefixes
